SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts the Postman API keys you add in the admin panel. Use at least 32 random characters: generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Changing it later means re-entering every stored key.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Needed only when REQUIRE_AUTH is "false": the password that unlocks the admin panel via POST /auth/admin-login. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 24`.

DB.description: D1 database storing users, tokens, settings, Postman accounts, uid maps and the audit log. Created automatically on first deploy; the Worker migrates its schema itself on the first request.
